answer: Flag identities that move in lockstep. Independent honest agents submit, attest, and vote with natural scatter in timing and targets; a farm driven by one operator leaves a tell — accounts that fire within the same narrow ledge of seconds and spiral toward the same vote choices in correlated waves. Cluster by this behavioral co-movement across the mesa of activity and the synchronized group stands out against honest variance. This stays a soft detection signal feeding the hard bond and quorum gates, never a standalone payment metric, so false positives cost nothing.
